name: Laporan Manajemen

endpoints.description: Breakdown harian + baris Total Weighbridge/Grading/Cages Track untuk mill milik acting user, dalam rentang tanggal terfilter

query_params.name: date_from
query_params.description: Filter tanggal awal; default awal bulan berjalan jika tidak diisi

query_params.name: date_to
query_params.description: Filter tanggal akhir; default hari ini jika tidak diisi

endpoints.description: Ekspor breakdown harian + baris Total ke CSV/Excel, mengikuti filter rentang tanggal yang sama

business_logic: 1. Resolve business_unit_id dari acting user (Mill Management selalu punya business_unit_id)
2. Validasi date_from/date_to: jika date_from > date_to, return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE
3. Default date_from ke awal bulan berjalan, date_to ke hari ini, jika tidak diisi

4. Untuk setiap tanggal dalam rentang (inklusif), agregasi weighbridge-record/grading-record/cages-track-record (+cages-tipped-time) yang di-scope ke business_unit_id user, sama seperti DashboardService tapi per-hari
5. Susun array rows (satu per tanggal) + hitung baris total (penjumlahan seluruh rows)

data_operations.description: Aggregate count + SUM(net_weight) per hari, scoped ke business_unit_id user
Aggregate count + SUM(netto) + SUM(quantity) per hari, scoped yang sama
Aggregate count per hari, scoped yang sama
JOIN ke cages-track-record dalam filter, SUM(total_cages) per hari

edge_case_handling.condition: Tidak ada data pada satu atau lebih hari dalam rentang
edge_case_handling.handling: Baris hari tersebut tetap muncul di rows dengan count/sum = 0

edge_case_handling.condition: Tidak ada data sama sekali di seluruh rentang
edge_case_handling.handling: rows berisi baris 0 untuk setiap tanggal, total = 0; export tetap menghasilkan file

business_rules_applied: Laporan otomatis dibatasi ke business unit milik Mill Management yang login
Filter tanggal default awal bulan berjalan sampai hari ini
Breakdown harian dari data gabungan sync mobile + input web
Baris Total menjumlahkan seluruh hari dalam rentang
Ekspor mengikuti filter rentang tanggal aktif
Laporan termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal

unit_test_cases.description: defaults date_from to start of current month and date_to to today when not provided
unit_test_cases.expect: aggregation runs with date range = start-of-month..today

unit_test_cases.description: returns one row per date in the range with correct aggregates
unit_test_cases.given: valid date range spanning 3 days, records exist on each day
unit_test_cases.expect: rows array has 3 entries, each with correct count/sums for that date

unit_test_cases.description: includes a zero-value row for a date with no matching records
unit_test_cases.given: date range spanning 2 days, only 1 day has records
unit_test_cases.expect: the day without records appears in rows with count=0 and sums=0, not omitted

unit_test_cases.description: computes total as the sum of all daily rows
unit_test_cases.expect: total.weighbridge.count = sum of rows[].weighbridge.count (and same pattern for other fields)

unit_test_cases.description: scopes aggregation to the acting user's own business_unit_id only
unit_test_cases.given: records exist for the user's business unit and for a different business unit
unit_test_cases.expect: rows/total only reflect the user's own business unit, other business unit's data excluded

unit_test_cases.description: aggregates cages_track total_cages_tipped across cages-tipped-time rows per day, not cages_out/cages_tipped
unit_test_cases.given: cages-track-record rows on a given day, each with multiple cages-tipped-time rows
unit_test_cases.expect: that day's total_cages_tipped = SUM(total_cages) across all cages-tipped-time rows for that day's headers

unit_test_cases.description: export() returns 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE when date_from > date_to
export() generates a CSV with one row per date plus a Total row
unit_test_cases.expect: streamed CSV body contains a header row, one row per date, and a final Total row

implementation_notes: Endpoint terpisah dari GET /api/dashboard/summary (screen-025) karena bentuk data berbeda: breakdown per-hari + Total, bukan satu snapshot rentang gabungan, dan scope business_unit_id otomatis dari acting user (bukan query param opsional)

ManagementReportService baru (bukan reuse DashboardService) agar per-entity aggregation query tidak perlu diubah jadi date-range-only vs per-day -- pola sama seperti WeighbridgeRecordService/GradingRecordService/CagesTrackRecordService yang masing-masing punya service sendiri
Export mengikuti pola WeighbridgeRecordService::export() -- CSV native, format=excel fallback ke CSV dengan xlsx mimetype/filename
route /reports/management dipilih agar tidak bentrok dengan /dashboard (screen-025) dan konsisten dengan namespace 'reports' untuk kemungkinan laporan lain di masa depan

component_test.action: mount component with default filter (start of month..today)
component_test.assert: rows table renders one row per date with correct aggregates, plus a Total row

browser_test.action: navigate to /reports/management after login as Mill Management
browser_test.assert: page shows daily breakdown table and Total row for the current month

component_test.action: change date range filter and apply
component_test.assert: rows/total update to match the filtered range

browser_test.action: fill date range filter and click Apply
browser_test.assert: report updates to show only the filtered range

browser_test.assert: page shows 0-value rows and a 'belum ada data' message, not an error

component_test.assert: validation error message shown, table keeps previous values

browser_test.assert: browser shows a validation error, filter is not applied
